name: AI Graphic Novel Production
description: A page-aware, continuity-controlled workflow for long-form sequential art.

tasks.name: Lock story and world
tasks.objective: Finalize outline, script, character bible, locations, props, wardrobe logic, visual motifs, and continuity rules before panel generation.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Story and character canon are versioned and stable.
Recurring visual facts are explicit enough to audit later pages.

tasks.name: Write page/panel script
tasks.objective: Break the script into pages and panels with composition, camera distance, action, emotional beat, dialogue/caption load, reveal timing, and page-turn intent. Keep an optional page-as-image route only for pages whose lettering and layout can still be corrected independently.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every page has a reading-order plan and narrative purpose.
Dialogue density fits available panel space.

tasks.name: Lock style and identities
tasks.objective: Build reusable character turnarounds, expressions, outfits, scale references, environment keys, palette/line/render rules, and reference prompts or adapters. Test consistency before producing finished pages.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Main characters reproduce recognizably across angle, expression, and outfit tests.
Style rules distinguish intentional variation from drift.

tasks.name: Generate and compose panels
tasks.objective: Generate panels from the structured script using references, pose/composition controls, image-to-image, layer separation, or local edits as needed. Produce backgrounds and figures separately when interaction or correction requires it.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Panel staging matches the page script.
Recurring characters, props, and locations remain canon-consistent.

tasks.name: Letter and assemble pages
tasks.objective: Assemble pages in layout software, establish gutters and bleed, place speech balloons/captions/SFX, enforce readable balloon order, and keep text as editable typography rather than baked generated pixels.

acceptanceCriteria.description: All prose and dialogue remain editable and proofreadable.

tasks.name: Audit page and sequence continuity
tasks.objective: Review pages individually and in sequence for character drift, handedness, geography, costume/prop state, eye-lines, palette, panel rhythm, lettering collisions, repeated compositions, and page-turn spoilers.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Findings identify exact page/panel and repair.
Sequence-level pacing and page-turn reveals are checked.

tasks.name: Prepress and export
tasks.objective: Apply targeted repairs, upscale only approved raster art, verify trim/bleed/color settings, package fonts or outlined text as required, and export print-ready plus digital editions with source pages preserved.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Print export meets chosen printer specifications.
Digital export preserves legibility at target devices.
Editable source and continuity bible are archived.
